title: Bind Tauri harness cleanup to exact process ownership
summary: Replace temporal/global process discovery in Tauri validation harnesses with exact launcher-descendant identity and creation-time revalidation before cleanup.
reason: Remediate P1 AUDIT-FIND-W09-009. Four active Tauri harnesses can currently observe and force-stop an unrelated Local API or shell that starts after their global baseline snapshot.
behavior_before: Harnesses treat every matching shell/backend PID absent from a global baseline as owned, select the first backend for evidence, and force-stop the entire delta during cleanup without parent or creation-time proof.
behavior_after: Harnesses discover only processes in the exact launcher process tree, retain PID plus creation-time identity, require one owned shell/backend where appropriate, and revalidate identity before any fallback tree termination. Ambiguous or unrelated processes are never cleanup targets.
tests_added: Concurrent disposable process trees prove descendant classification excludes an unrelated tree.
Creation-time mismatch proves PID reuse cannot authorize termination.
Static harness contracts reject baseline/delta backend ownership and raw PID cleanup.
manual_validation: PowerShell parser validation passed for the shared helper and all four changed harnesses.
Disposable concurrent-tree adversarial wrapper passed ownership isolation, PID/creation-time mismatch refusal, exact child cleanup, and unrelated-tree survival.
Tauri shell scaffold plus PG-1 adversarial scaffold passed 125 tests; targeted Ruff passed.
Canonical Test-TauriShell-Launch.ps1 dev launch/close smoke passed with one exact launcher-owned shell and backend and no media launch.

A concurrent unrelated Python process matching the historical local_api_main selector started after the harness launcher checkpoint, survived successful harness cleanup, and was then stopped by its separately captured exact fixture identity.
Test-TauriShell-Build.ps1 -SkipLinkCheck passed Node syntax, cargo check, and 68 Rust lifecycle/library tests.
Targeted summary freshness plus project-index/dependency-graph and feature-map check modes passed.
Canonical risky-file registry validation and targeted git diff --check passed (line-ending warnings only).
Strict worktree coverage passed with 1167 valid change packets.
rollback_plan: Revert the shared helper, four harness integrations, tests, lifecycle documentation, generated outputs, and this packet together. Do not restore global baseline-delta cleanup without a replacement exact-ownership mechanism.
notes: No media-policy or source-file behavior changes. A second genuine Local API cannot be used as a normal success-path fixture because the backend-instance lease correctly makes the Tauri-owned backend fail closed; the live selector-spoof test covers the historical concurrent matching-process hazard without violating that invariant. The audit's representative PG-1/PG-2 active-work/real-media validation remains an external gate, so this packet stays in progress until that evidence exists.
